page.overview:
Who is Gecko?

Gecko is a minor antagonist in Invincible, debuting in Atom Eve's backstory.

Gecko is one of the members of the Lizard League who participated the battle between them and the Guardians. His current status and whereabouts is unknown.

Little is known about his backstory. At some point, he joined the Lizard League.

In 2004, he and the other Lizard League members, along with the queen and the prince, raided the facility. When the Guardians of the Globe appeared, they engaged in battle, with Gecko seen dodging Aquarus’s attacks. Gecko began clutching his throat while struggling to breathe before Aquarus attacked him again, but he managed to dodge it once more. He was ultimately knocked out by War Woman.
